title: Bulk Step Builder for XrmToolBox
description: Build multiple Microsoft Dataverse plugin steps for one selected class. Inspect a local DLL, choose a class, select tables and configure messages, stages, execution mode and per-table Update filtering attributes. Review the batch before registering the assembly, class and new steps. Existing steps are preserved, with individual results and CSV export.
tags: XrmToolBox Dataverse Dynamics365 PowerPlatform PluginRegistration BulkSteps
releaseNotes: 1.0.0: Promote the user-validated 0.1.7 implementation to the 1.0 release line. NuGet package version is 1.0.0 and assembly version is 1.0.0.0. This is a version-only release; plugin registration behavior is unchanged. Includes explicit class selection, searchable tables, per-table Update attributes, batch preview, duplicate detection, signing guidance, actionable errors and CSV export.
